entries.title: Psalms 121:1
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Hills - To Sion and Moriah, which are called the holy mountains.

entries.title: Psalms 121:5
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Shade - To keep thee from the burning heat of the sun.

entries.title: Psalms 121:6
entries.author: John Wesley (1703–1791)
entries.content: Smite - With excessive heat. Moon - With that cold and moisture which come into the air by it. Intemperate heats and colds are the springs of many diseases.
